item.title: Get Your Live Music Fix in Chicago with the GigScout App
item.description: The GigScout app makes it simple to find the venues closest to your location, pick an artist by listening to a quick clip of their music, and buy tickets.

item.title: 5 Ways to Celebrate St. Patrick’s Day in Chicago - The Chicago Lifestyle

item.title: Chicago's Hit New Band, The Central Standard Band
item.description: Chicago's new bluesy-alt-rock band, The Central Standard, is performing at Double Door on May 9 and releasing an album in June.

item.description: Restaurants across Chicago have partnered with C2E2 to highlight pop culture phenomenons through gastronomical food in honor of the expo coming April 24-26.

item.title: Celebrate the Summer at Ravinia
item.description: Chicagoans are a short train ride away from all that Ravinia has to offer; music performances, dining options, and large, grassy lawns.

item.description: Heating & Cooling Pub, also known as HVAC Pub, is just a couple of steps from Wrigley Field and serves up amazing appetizers, craft beers, and pizza like you’ve never seen before.
